market_method: B134 Ridge100 and empirical normalized-return distribution; trained on Gold KOSPI; gold_market uses Gold only, optional US/EWY asof KRX close, not next-morning data
timing: Quarterly OOS market predictions for every stock training/calibration/test row. Matured labels only. Market actual only used to estimate historical beta; never inference input.
anchor: Train residual target = stock actual - beta * OOS market forecast. Not actual future market subtraction. All four shocks retained; contributions equal model difference.
limitations: Repeated development evaluation. US/EWY availability uses source assumed market clocks, not certified receipt. Not a no-shock counterfactual. Previous-year OOS residual intervals, overlapping rows are not independent events.
